```{r}
# Load dataset
data("nottem")

# Convert to time series object
ts_data <- nottem

```


```{r}
# Plot the series
plot(ts_data, main="Monthly Average Air Temperatures at Nottingham",
     ylab="Temperature (F)", xlab="Year")
#Load forecasting libraries
library(forecast)
library(tseries)
```



```{r}
#check for stationarity
adf.test(ts_data)

#apply seasonal differencing
ts_diff <- diff(ts_data, lag=12)
plot(ts_diff)
```

```{r}
#Fit an ARIMA/SARIMA model
model <- auto.arima(ts_data, seasonal=TRUE)
summary(model)
```
```{r}
#forecast the values
forecast_values <- forecast(model, h=24)

print(forecast_values)
plot(forecast_values)
```
```{r}
#extract the forecasted values
forecast_values$mean
```
